title: lathyrus japonicus var. pubescens
intro: Lathyrus japonicus var. pubescens, commonly known as hairy pea, is a perennial flowering plant in the pea family. It is native to East Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The hairy pea plant has been found to possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as relieving pain, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus japonicus var. pubescens include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
